title: A new paid ticket or product charges at least $3

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19, pricing decision card: "Yes, $3 minimum" (project thread: Rethink our take rates). ADR-1978.

detail: Under $3 most of a sale is the card fee, and from the pass-through date that fee is the seller's. The floor is PAID_PRICE_MIN_CENTS (300, the same number as the paid membership floor) in lib/billing/paid-price-floor.ts. Every writer asks it: createProduct and updateProduct, upsertVariants, the ticket tier editor (applyTicketTierFloor: a fixed tier at least $3, a new buyer-chosen tier gets a $3 floor when left blank), the Journey sell action, and the admin event flat price. Free stays free; a price stored before the rule keeps selling; tips and donations keep their $1 minimum.

verify.note: Fails unless the $3 floor is one number and every ticket and product price writer asks it.
